description: Clear a Cloudflare challenge and return a token. `gate` is "turnstile" for an embedded widget (there is a data-sitekey in the page) or "waf" for a full-page Cloudflare interstitial. `sitekey` and `url` are both required; the url must be the page the challenge actually renders on, because a sitekey is bound to its configured hostnames. Tokens are single-use and expire in minutes — request one at the moment you submit. Failed solves are never billed. Requires SOLVEGATE_API_KEY.

action.description: Optional Turnstile action label, if the widget sets one

proxy.description: Optional egress proxy URL to solve through

url.description: The page URL the challenge renders on

name: solve_turnstile

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds after which the token is worthless

mode.description: sandbox tokens NEVER clear a real gate

token.description: Submit this as the cf-turnstile-response field

title: Solve a Cloudflare Turnstile or WAF challenge
